---
description: Start multi-agent work using the repository team workflow
---

Follow `team/TEAM.md` and `team/INTAKE.md`, plus repository instructions. Inspect the
relevant code first, classify the goal, and ask only blocking questions. For multi-step
work, create or update `team/STATE.md` from `team/STATE.template.md`. Delegate only to
available agents, with bounded non-overlapping scopes. Do not require approval unless a
repository rule or shared decision gate requires it. Goal: ${input:goal}
